business_summary: Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. provides mechatronics, display, industrial machinery, and electronics related products in Japan and internationally. It offers burnishing systems, UV curing equipment, hard disk and semiconductor conveyor systems, automated handling machines, semiconductor handlers, Peltier systems, conveyor and bagging lines, factory automation equipment, and solar water and cell manufacturing and research and development tools; automated machinery business carrier tape business electronic components business; laser business ion beam business; hair analysis, biomarker analysis, and Eliza kit business; and shirt finishing system, wool finisher, uniform finishers, tumbler, bagging system, distributor, apparel equipment, and maintenance support. The company also provides precision polishing systems, handling technology solutions, cutting technology equipment, precision machining systems, laser technology equipment, and chemical solution application technology; medical products, healthcare products, electronic devices, printer-related equipment, fully automated hair mounting machines, fully automated hair slicing machines, and disease analysis technology solutions; and control technology systems, communication technology systems, general measurement equipment, optical measurement equipment, clothing drying, pressing and packaging equipment, mold heaters, and optical automatic double-sided inspection systems. Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Y.A.C. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Y.A.C. Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.
